final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor provided no new admissible evidence and mostly narrowed the claim by conceding that clean compliance is not established on the present record. That reframing is analytically better, but it does not satisfy the governing policy. The admissible evidence still shows a 1.2 percentage point miss in a segment named in two pilot commitments, an open Legal question on disclosure, and a policy requiring disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. Because none of those closing predicates is evidenced, the packet remains noncompliant. A caveated certification posture may be a narrower business framing, but here the caveat itself is the unresolved compliance predicate, so it is not enough for compliant_with_caveats.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the legal intake triage gap was resolved before launch.
No admissible evidence shows disclosure was completed for this named launch use case.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance covering non-disclosure before launch.
Legal review remains open, so the policy predicate is unresolved.
Aggregate readiness and stable rehearsal do not cure materiality for a named customer-committed use case.
Model-card documentation and post-launch monitoring are governance measures, not substitutes for the policy requirement.
